title: Shark Motorcycle Helmets with 5-Star SHARP Ratings
desc: Models on SHARP’s Shark manufacturer page that received the maximum five-star rating. Every item is tied at five stars; this is not an order of superiority. Ratings apply to the named model and tested configuration.

source.name: UK Department for Transport — SHARP Shark helmet ratings
source.note: All seven named Shark models and five-star ratings were checked against the official UK Department for Transport SHARP brand page and its model-rating list by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-21. SHARP identifies ratings as model-specific safety assessments; all entries tie at the maximum five stars and are not ranked against one another.
